latest_release.name: v3.6.0
latest_release.body:
## 核心更新

1. 新增：定时任务脚本插件与沙箱调度体系，支持导入脚本文件或插件包并自动生成可视化表单、加密保存账号密码与会话状态、按计划执行保活或签到，并在桌面端「定时任务」页面及手机端完整适配。
2. 新增：内置可视化定时任务插件制作与编辑工具，提供常见模板、实时交互预览、域权限管控与安全试跑能力。
3. 新增：请求隐私脱敏保护，在内容发出本机前自动识别并遮罩密钥、个人隐私信息及自定义保密词，并在收到回复时透明还原，原始敏感内容仅驻留内存、不写入磁盘或日志；指纹脱敏默认仅作用于 WorkBuddy 国内版与国际版。
4. 新增：本机直连使用记录采集，可读取未经过代理网关的本地客户端直接调用记录并去重合并进请求日志与统计报表，支持识别 Antigravity 本机当前账号归属及按需读取原文。
5. 优化：重构账号配额卡片与详情弹层布局，将剩余百分比与恢复倒计时合并至同一行展示并取消进度条下方孤立倒计时行，使左右分组进度条水平对齐，支持多组折行与窄列自适应；同时收敛模型组全部受限时的短窗展示，并修正满额与小数舍入引发的状态误判。
6. 优化：重塑插件页面布局与任务进度体验，新增「其他插件 → 定时任务」分类入口，升级插件批量安装、更新、启停、卸载及本地脚本安装的统一任务弹窗与后台进度条，未签名插件改为安装前二次确认。

## 其他更新

1. 新增：支持 New API 类自定义通道的账号余额与订阅额度解析展示。
2. 修复：修复标题生成路由因客户端标识大小写及分隔符不一致导致无法命中的问题，以及商店定时任务插件下载误用图标地址导致的校验失败问题。
3. 优化：完善网络代理对 EasyClash 节点的存活检测、轮询全选自动跳过未就绪节点以及删除代理时恢复默认更新线路；固定请求详情切换栏并优化长内容防溢出体验。
4. 优化：完善桌面端安装卸载残留清理与协议文件保护，补齐桌面端系统托盘、原生弹窗及新增界面的六语言翻译，并优化统计报表筛选、日志工具栏、维护页、签到福利面板及 AI 助手细节。
5. 更新：完善定时任务插件自动更新检测、商店接入及多仓库发版流程，同步桌面端与手机端构建产物。
6. 版本：3.5.1 → 3.6.0

# Agent2API **An AI routing gateway with Agent client takeover, unifying model APIs and local client configuration** **English** | [简体中文](./docs/README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./docs/README.zh-Hant.md) | [日本語](./docs/README.ja.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md) | [Português (BR)](./docs/README.pt-BR.md) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-AGPL--3.0-green)](./LICENSE) [![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/aimod-cc/Agent2API?include_prereleases)](https://github.com/aimod-cc/Agent2API/releases/latest) [![docker pulls](https://img.shields.io/docker/pulls/aimodcc/agent2api)](https://hub.docker.com/r/aimodcc/agent2api) [![stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/aimod-cc/Agent2API?style=flat&color=yellow)](https://github.com/aimod-cc/Agent2API/stargazers) [![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux%20%7C%20Docker-blue)](https://github.com/aimod-cc/Agent2API/releases/latest) [✨ Key Features](#-key-features) • [💬 Community & Support](#-community--support) • [🚀 Quick Start](#-quick-start) • [📦 Installation & deployment](./docs/install.en.md) • [📸 Screenshots](#-screenshots) • [🔧 Development & Build](#-development--build) • [📜 Usage Notice](#-usage-notice)
--- Agent2API is an **AI routing gateway with Agent client takeover**. It exposes a unified model API for custom AI providers and centralizes account routing, model mapping, gateway keys and request reports. It also manages local Agent clients' connection profiles, including importing, switching and previewing configuration changes. ## ✨ Key Features - 🔌 **Unified model APIs** — OpenAI Chat / Responses / Images and Anthropic Messages, with a unified model catalog; Raccoon, Loomy, Antigravity, ModelScope, WorkBuddy and Doubao Work supply image generation, while Raccoon, Loomy, Antigravity, ModelScope and WorkBuddy also support reference-image editing. Both are available as AI assistant tools - 🧭 **AI routing** — model mapping, account priority, load balancing, session affinity and failover in one place - 🤖 **Agent client takeover** — manage multiple connection profiles for local clients, import existing settings, preview writes and switch between the gateway and custom services - 🧩 **Plugin extensions** — additional providers are installed and updated separately, with regions and quota pools kept isolated. The former foundation packages now include CodeArts chat, official sign-in, managed renewal and benefits; CatPaw chat, tool continuation, image input and authorized live desktop accounts; Doubao Work chat, asynchronous replies, image upload/generation, sign-in, desktop import, check-in and task rewards; and separate MonkeyCode China/International chat tasks, tool bridges, sign-in and daily check-in. MonkeyCode tasks and desktop credential access require explicit permission. Kiro managed sign-in and explicitly enrolled Cline Free renewal remain available. These source implementations have not been verified with live accounts. - 🧰 **Web tool emulation** — a shared gateway layer converts tools and their history/results for explicitly declared Zhipu Qingyan, DeepSeek Web and Tabbit models. Enabled by default with an off switch; not native web functionality and not yet verified with live accounts. - 🛡️ **Egress proxies** — select proxy-pool exits for accounts and update tasks - 🔑 **Gateway security** — scoped gateway keys, optional human verification for panel sign-in, and model requests refused by default until a key is configured - 📊 **Request reports** — request volume, success rate, token usage, cache hit rate and a 365-day heatmap - ⏰ **Background maintenance** — model catalog refresh, credential maintenance and software update checks; daily check-in runs per provider on that provider's own window (Qoder 10:01, ZCode 19:01, others follow the schedule time), plus a catch-up round that only touches accounts not yet checked in; additional provider-specific tasks are supplied by plugins - 🖥️ **Three deployment forms** — Windows / macOS / Linux desktop apps, headless Windows / Linux servers and Docker (amd64 / arm64); no Node runtime required, with a six-language interface ## ❤️ Sponsors Thanks to Beichen API, IPWO and ProxyLane for sponsoring this project.

Beichen API		 One API for multiple leading model providers.
Beichen offers an OpenAI-compatible AI API relay with streaming responses and connection support for long-reasoning models. Select the first card in Agent2API's Add account → API templates, then enter your own API key alongside the prefilled endpoint.

Register / Get an API key ↗

IPWO Residential IPs		 Rotating, static and unlimited residential proxy plans.
IPWO offers residential IPs across multiple regions, with country- and city-level targeting and HTTP(S) / SOCKS5 support. Add the proxy address in Agent2API's Network proxy page for use by accounts and service routes.

Explore plans / Get residential IPs ↗

ProxyLane Static ISP		 Dedicated native static residential ISP proxies for AI accounts.
IPs come from real home broadband operators with low Scamalytics fraud scores, and each IP is dedicated to you with unlimited traffic starting from $3.90. Add one exit per account on Agent2API's Network proxy page. Use code AGENT2API25 for 25% off your first purchase.

Explore plans / Get static IPs ↗
## 💬 Community & Support - **QQ groups**: Agent2API chat groups; search the group number in QQ to join. - Group 1: `1127656296` - Group 2: `1130894674` - Group 3: `1108276647` - **Telegram group**: - **💖 Donate**: if Agent2API helps you, you are welcome to [buy the author a coffee](./docs/SPONSOR.md); donations are voluntary and unlock nothing. - **🤝 Sponsorship / business**: want to sponsor the project, or feature your product here? Email [541675139@qq.com](mailto:541675139@qq.com). ## 🚀 Quick start Three forms — pick the one that matches your setup; **the complete install, upgrade, uninstall and troubleshooting guide is in [Installation & deployment](./docs/install.en.md)**. | Form | Artifact | Interface | | --- | --- | --- | | **Desktop** (Windows / macOS / Linux) | `Agent2API__x64-setup.exe`, `_universal.dmg`, `_amd64.deb`, `_amd64.AppImage` | App window | | **Server** (Windows Server / Linux, headless) | `agent2api-server-windows-amd64.zip`, `agent2api-server-linux-.tar.gz` | Browser panel | | **Docker** | `aimodcc/agent2api:latest` (amd64 / arm64) | Browser panel | **Desktop**: add a custom provider and account, create a gateway key, then apply a connection profile on the Agent page or configure your client with `http://127.0.0.1:3065/v1` and that key. Additional provider capabilities require the corresponding plugin. **Server** (no GUI; registered as a system service and started at boot): ```bash # Linux tar -xzf agent2api-server-linux-amd64.tar.gz && cd agent2api-server-linux-amd64 && sudo bash install.sh ``` ```powershell # Windows Server (administrator PowerShell) Expand-Archive agent2api-server-windows-amd64.zip -DestinationPath C:\agent2api-pkg cd C:\agent2api-pkg; .\install-service.ps1 ``` **Docker**: ```bash docker run -d --name agent2api --restart unless-stopped -p 3065:3065 -v ./data:/data aimodcc/agent2api:latest ``` Whichever form you pick, open the panel afterwards (`http://127.0.0.1:3065/`; use the host IP for the server and Docker forms), register the admin account, then create a key on the "Gateway Keys" page. Connectivity check: `curl http://127.0.0.1:3065/health` **Mobile**: open `http://:3065/m` in a browser (you can "Add to Home Screen" for a full-screen PWA). For a standalone icon, install `Agent2API-.apk` (Android) or `Agent2API-.ipa` (iOS, unsigned — re-sign it yourself) from the Release. Details: [Install & deploy → Mobile](./docs/install.en.md#mobile). ## 📸 Screenshots ### Accounts ![Accounts page: global queue, per-model rate-limit cooldown, expiry and balance](./assets/screenshots/accounts.png) Add account: ![Add account: choose provider and edition, then sign in on the web](./assets/screenshots/add-account.png) ### Model management ![Model management: per-provider model catalog with rate, context and mappings](./assets/screenshots/models.png) ### Report Overview: requests / success rate / tokens / top model, with account and provider rankings, usage donuts and a 365-day activity heatmap: ![Report overview: stat cards, top accounts / providers, model and provider usage donuts](./assets/screenshots/report-overview.png) Trends: 24-hour **cache hit rate** (line) and **token consumption** (area) on twin axes, with a per-day token bar chart below: ![Report trends: dual-axis cache hit rate and token consumption, per-day token bars](./assets/screenshots/report-trends.png) ## 🔧 Development & Build ### Requirements - Rust >= 1.77 and the Tauri 2 toolchain (to compile the desktop app itself; Windows also needs the WebView2 runtime) - Node.js >= 18.17 (only to run `npm run tauri:*` and frontend build scripts; the desktop app does not depend on Node at runtime) - Target platforms: Windows / macOS / Linux desktops, headless Windows / Linux servers, and a Docker server ### Common scripts ```bash npm run tauri:install # Install desktop dependencies (same as npm --prefix desktop-tauri install) npm run tauri:dev # Launch the desktop app in dev mode (with hot reload) npm run tauri:build # Build the desktop installer npm run build:icon # Generate the icon source image (run after changing the icon design, then run tauri icon) ``` The build artifact is `target/release/bundle/nsis/Agent2API__x64-setup.exe` (about 8.6 MB as of 3.0; `src-tauri/.cargo/config.toml` points cargo's `target-dir` at the project root's `target/`). The macOS `.dmg` **can only be built on macOS** (`npm --prefix desktop-tauri run build -- --target universal-apple-darwin`) — it cannot be cross-compiled from Windows, so the official artifact comes from the CI `build` workflow (`macos-latest`, two targets merged). Docker images and the server archives used for in-container updates come from the same workflow's `linux-server` job, which reuses the Dockerfile's compile path so the executable inside is built from the same toolchain as the image. ## 📜 Usage Notice ### Credential and data security Account credentials are encrypted in the local database, but exports, backups and key files may still contain sensitive data. Keep them private; do not upload them to public repositories or cloud storage, or share them with others. ### No warranty The project is provided "as is", without guarantees of availability, stability, security or suitability for a particular purpose. Trademarks and services belong to their respective owners. The complete license and warranty terms are in [LICENSE](./LICENSE). ## 📄 License This project uses the same [GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0)](./LICENSE) as the provider plugin repository. Use, modification and distribution, including commercial use, are permitted under the license. Preserve copyright and license notices and fulfill applicable source-code obligations. If you offer a modified version over a network, you must offer its Corresponding Source to those users. ## ⭐ Star History
